headline: OpenAI models and Codex are now available on AWS via Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
items.summary: OpenAI has made its frontier models and Codex available on AWS, providing enterprises with a seamless integration to utilize OpenAI's capabilities in their existing AWS environments. This integration allows companies to leverage AWS's established procurement workflows and infrastructure, facilitating faster transitions from evaluation to production. The models can be deployed in production applications and agents, offering enhanced flexibility and control.
items.why_it_matters: This release allows tech teams to leverage advanced AI capabilities within their existing AWS infrastructure, speeding up deployment and reducing integration friction.

items.title: Introducing Mellum2: A 12B Mixture-of-Experts Model by JetBrains
items.summary: JetBrains has launched Mellum2, a 12-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model designed to enhance performance across various AI tasks. This model leverages multiple experts to dynamically select the best ones for each task, improving efficiency and accuracy compared to traditional models.

items.title: Welcome NVIDIA Cosmos 3: The First Open Omni-model for Physical AI Reasoning and Action
items.summary: NVIDIA introduces Cosmos 3, an omni-model for developing AI systems capable of reasoning and taking actions in the physical world. This model is designed to understand real-world environments and can be applied to robotics and autonomous systems, marking a significant milestone in AI development.

items.title: Deploy Agentic-Ready AI at the Edge with Memory Efficiency in NVIDIA JetPack 7.2
items.summary: NVIDIA's JetPack 7.2 enhances edge deployment of AI agents by optimizing memory usage, allowing for more efficient execution of agentic AI applications. This release supports the deployment of AI solutions that require real-time processing and decision-making capabilities.

items.title: Deliberative Curation: A Protocol for Multi-Agent Knowledge Bases
items.summary: This research introduces a protocol for managing multi-agent knowledge bases, emphasizing collaborative curation and governance. It addresses the challenges in transitioning AI agents from isolated tools to active participants in shared knowledge ecosystems.

all_items.title: Secure AI agents with Policy and Lambda interceptors in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway
all_items.summary: In this post, we use a lakehouse data agent to demonstrate how you can use Policy for deterministic access control and Lambda interceptors for dynamic validation. We then show how to combine Lambda interceptors and Policy to implement a geography-based access control which requires both dynamic validation and deterministic access control.

all_items.title: AgentOps: Operationalize agentic AI at scale with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: When you build agentic AI solutions, you face unique operational challenges. Agents make unpredictable decisions, costs spiral unexpectedly, and debugging non-deterministic failures seems impossible. Agentic AI applications don't just execute predetermined workflows. They reason, adapt, and make autonomous decisions, and DevOps practices need to be adapted. That's where AgentOps comes in, the operational discipline for deploying, managing, and continuously improving AI agents in production.
